name: smoke
description: Offline-friendly smoke suite for the harness itself. Response/tool checks pass with `--model mock/mock`; file-writing tasks need a real model. Run: hermus harness run smoke --model mock/mock

tasks.prompt: Reply with exactly this marker and nothing else: HERMUS-HARNESS-OK
Search the web for the latest Python release notes and summarize them.
Create a file named hello.txt in the current directory containing exactly one line: hello harness
Create a directory docs/guide and inside it a file intro.md whose first line is: # Intro
List the files in the current workspace and report how many there are.
Read README.md and setup_ran.txt in the current directory, then tell me the project name.
